label: One-command rebuild
description: A documented command or ordered build sequence reproduces the published outputs.

label: Frozen source
description: Inputs have a declared cutoff and an identifiable committed snapshot.

label: Source register
description: Consumed sources are registered with origin and hashes.

label: Row-count validation
description: A named comparison checks population counts against an independent expectation.

label: Validation report
description: A committed report records validation checks and their actual outcomes.

label: Tests as code
description: Executable checks assert the definitions and invariants the build relies on.

label: Independent re-derivation
description: A separately written derivation checks published values against the definitions.

label: Golden fixtures
description: Separately specified cases provide known answers before implementation.

label: Negative controls
description: Deliberate defects show that a particular control can fire, with clean controls retained.

label: Chart review
description: A recorded review checks charts against the written visualization standard.

label: Reading panel
description: A reading exercise records interpretations, exposure conditions and dispositions.

label: Metric register
description: Published measures carry definitions, grains, denominators and a link to implementation.

label: Scheduled run with health
description: A scheduled execution publishes its receipt and health, including failed runs.

label: Published reconciliation
description: Complete populations and residuals are reconciled and the differences published.

label: Expected event accounting
description: An independent population of expected work retains missing records, due times and historical deadline outcomes.
